mapper.select: SELECT CAST(t.bti_idx AS VARCHAR) AS tree_id, CASE WHEN t.bti_refidx IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE CAST(t.bti_refidx AS VARCHAR) END AS parent_tree_id, t.bti_name AS tree_name, t.bti_type AS node_type, t.bti_target AS target, t.bti_category AS category_code, t.bti_minrecommend AS min_recommend, NULL::BIGINT AS bi_idx, NULL::INTEGER AS recommend_count, CASE WHEN t.bti_type IN ('ROOT', 'CATEGORY', 'RECOMMEND') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_parent FROM board_tree_info t WHERE t.bti_group = 'BOARD' AND t.bti_useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY t.bti_level, t.bti_refidx NULLS FIRST, t.bti_seq

SELECT 'POST_' || #{parentTreeId} || '_' || CAST(b.bi_idx AS VARCHAR) AS tree_id, #{parentTreeId} AS parent_tree_id, b.bi_title AS tree_name, 'POST' AS node_type, 'BOARD_DETAIL' AS target, #{categoryCode} AS category_code, #{minRecommend} AS min_recommend, b.bi_idx AS bi_idx, CAST(COUNT(r.bri_idx) AS INTEGER) AS recommend_count, FALSE AS is_parent FROM board_info b LEFT JOIN board_recommend_info r ON b.bi_idx = r.bi_idx WHERE b.bi_type = 1 AND b.bi_category = #{categoryCode} GROUP BY b.bi_idx, b.bi_title HAVING COUNT(r.bri_idx) >= #{minRecommend} ORDER BY COUNT(r.bri_idx) DESC, b.bi_idx DESC
